These checks detect unconditional acceptance and partial deduction.

Validation regressions cover malformed JSON, container/order/item shapes, duplicate IDs/SKUs, unknown SKUs and invalid quantities; the mock boundary check establishes that a later invalid order prevents engine invocation.
